Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee: Keith Mclaughlin (E032), contractor Analyst, requesting write access to Source Code.

Policy:
- contractor employees: read, or write if they have advanced security training. Never admin.

Notes say:
- Note 1: contractor, no record of training available, recommend read.
- Note 2: contractor, basic security training, recommend read.

Both notes agree: contractor with at most basic training, no advanced training. So maximum supportable level is read. Requested write is above maximum, so grant maximum = read.

Submit decision: read.
